text:
harsha: quick huddle ": we need an emergency pinning + retirement calendar for models that unexpectedly regress after infra/quant changes. core asks: immediate mitigation steps, customer SLA carve-outs, finance impact estimate, and a calendar we can publish.
gina: propose a 3-tier response: 1) immediate pin (stop auto-updates) + notify customer 2) soft-retire (alias + canary) 3) scheduled retirement (formal comms + credits).
ivan: mitigation steps: - create pin_override=true for tenant record - spawn emergency canary with 0%->5% ramp in 1h - enable request_annotations for post-migration diffs. also a quick rollback toggle.
jules: comms templates: short advisory for "we detected a change"; technical annex with simulator report link; SLA note if customer is enterprise (include optional phone support). cadence: immediate, 48h follow-up, 7d decision.
kai: finance: need an immediate calc of potential credit exposure if we auto-credit all affected tenants. quick heuristic: credit = min(monthly_spend*0.1, $1000). we'll tighten after risk scoring. also mark credits as pending in ledger namespace migration_pending.
harsha: telemetry: build a rapid-diff metric that runs within 30m: compare last 24h sample vs baseline across p95, embed cosine, and hallucination flag rate. output risk_tag: green/amber/red. red -> auto-pin.
gina: policy nuance: enterprise tenants default to opt-out of auto-migrate; but for emergency red risk we still want to pin and then negotiate. document must state "pin-first, discuss-second" for SLA-bound accounts.
ivan: runtime change: SDK compatibility header X-Model-Compat that surfaces runtime differences (e.g., tokenization change, function-call op) so clients can log. add to catalog metadata an array compat_issues[].
jules: ops playbook step-by-step: 1) detect diff (auto) 2) compute rapid risk score 3) if red -> pin & notify 4) run simulator if allowed 5) open migration ticket + assign CSM 6) schedule canary if needed 7) finalize retirement calendar. include hard rollback commands in runbook.
kai: finance flag: add tenant_metadata migration_credit_eligibility (enum: auto, review, none) and credit_pool_id for chargebacks. legal: we need a one-liner in comms about credits being discretionary pending review.
harsha: owner assignments: gina owns policy doc + calendar, ivan owns runtime flags + emergency pin implementation, jules owns comms + runbook, kai owns finance schema. meet Wed 9am to validate the rapid-diff thresholds. :spiral_calendar_pad: notify-bot: alert: emergency-pin schema patch merged to staging for review.
